theme: Xử lý xung đột trong nhóm

vocab.example: I brought them together to address it head-on, without blame.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đưa họ lại với nhau để giải quyết trực tiếp, không đổ lỗi ai.

vocab.meaning_vi: làm dịu tình huống căng thẳng
vocab.example: Did you try to de-escalate the situation right away?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có cố gắng làm dịu tình huống ngay lập tức không?

vocab.example: Two teammates had a difference of opinion about the project design.
vocab.example_vi: Hai đồng nghiệp có sự khác biệt quan điểm về thiết kế dự án.

vocab.meaning_vi: khoảng thời gian để bình tĩnh lại
vocab.example: We agreed on a short cool-down period before talking again.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi thống nhất có một khoảng thời gian ngắn để bình tĩnh trước khi nói chuyện lại.

vocab.meaning_vi: sự va chạm, mâu thuẫn nhỏ

vocab.example: I asked them to step back and listen to each other calmly.

vocab.meaning_vi: giải quyết trong hoà bình, ổn thoả

listening.title: Phỏng vấn: xử lý xung đột trong nhóm

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: Tell me about a time you had to handle conflict in your team.

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Sure. Two teammates had a difference of opinion about the project design.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: How did you first respond to that friction?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I asked them to step back and listen to each other calmly.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: Did you try to de-escalate the situation right away?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, we agreed on a short cool-down period before talking again.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: What did you do after that break?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I brought them together to address it head-on, without blame.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: Did you get to the root of it during that conversation?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, it turned out to be a simple miscommunication about scope.

lines.speaker: Huong (Interviewer)
lines.text: How did the conflict finally end?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: We resolved it amicably, and the project stayed on schedule.

questions.q: What caused the friction between the two teammates?
options: A difference of opinion about design

questions.q: What did Duc suggest before talking again?
What was the real cause of the conflict?

shadowing: I asked both teammates to step back and listen calmly.
We agreed on a short cool-down period before talking again.
I wanted to address it head-on without blaming anyone at all.
We finally got to the root of a simple miscommunication.
In the end, we resolved everything amicably and stayed on schedule.
